title: sambucus nigra subsp. peruviana
intro: Sambucus nigra subsp. peruviana, commonly known as Black Elderberry, is a plant species within the Sambucus genus, native to Peru and known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Black Elderberry include its ability to reduce the severity and duration of cold and flu symptoms, as well as its potential to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Black Elderberry include its antiviral, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been traditionally used to treat respiratory tract infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Black Elderberry include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
